theme.title: The Worm
theme.subtitle: Dennis Rodman
theme.recap: Dennis Rodman, a second-round pick, won seven straight rebounding titles and grabbed rebounds at a rate not seen since Wilt.

questions.prompt: Dennis Rodman led the NBA in rebounding for how many seasons in a row?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also led the NBA in rebounds per game for a record seven consecutive years and won five NBA championships.

funFacts.text: Rodman originally played small forward before reinventing himself as a relentless power forward.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman played at the small forward position in his early years before becoming a power forward

funFacts.text: His number was eventually retired by the Pistons, and he entered the Hall of Fame that same year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Pistons retired Rodman's No.

funFacts.text: The Worm even entered professional wrestling, joining Hulk Hogan's nWo faction.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was a member of the nWo and fought alongside Hulk Hogan

questions.prompt: What did Dennis Rodman average in rebounds in 1991–92, his first rebounding title?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He collected an astounding 18.7 per game, winning his first of seven consecutive rebounding crowns

funFacts.text: Rodman made his first All-NBA team during the season when his rebounding suddenly exploded.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: and making his first All-NBA Team

funFacts.text: Kevin Willis argued Rodman could focus so completely on boards because he had few offensive duties.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Willis lamented that Rodman had an advantage in winning the rebounding title with his lack of offensive responsibilities

funFacts.text: Detroit's bruising identity had already produced back-to-back titles while Rodman was developing as a defender.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Detroit beat Portland in five games and claimed their second title

questions.prompt: What was Dennis Rodman's career high in rebounds, set in March 1992?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In a March 1992 game, Rodman grabbed a career-high 34 rebounds.

funFacts.text: The rising Knicks eliminated the aging Detroit Pistons in the first round of that spring's playoffs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the aging Pistons were eliminated by the up-and-coming New York Knicks in the first round

funFacts.text: Longtime coach Chuck Daly resigned not long after, a blow to Rodman, who saw him as a father figure.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: coach Chuck Daly, whom he had admired as a surrogate father, resigned

funFacts.text: Before rebounding defined his legend, Rodman won consecutive Defensive Player of the Year awards.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won his second Defensive Player of the Year Award

questions.prompt: Dennis Rodman was drafted in the second round in 1986. What overall pick was he?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: as the third pick in the second round (27th overall)

funFacts.text: Rodman played at Southeastern Oklahoma State, far from the NCAA's traditional blueblood programs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Southeastern Oklahoma State

funFacts.text: His performance at the Portsmouth Invitational Tournament was what helped catch Detroit's eye.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: where he won Most Valuable Player honors and caught the attention of the Detroit Pistons

funFacts.text: He joined Chuck Daly's 'Bad Boys,' with Isiah Thomas and Joe Dumars leading the backcourt.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: joining the rugged team of coach Chuck Daly that was called "Bad Boys"

questions.prompt: Rodman's 1991–92 rebound total was the most since Wilt Chamberlain's total in 1971–72. How many did Wilt grab that season?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 1,530 season rebounds (the most since Wilt Chamberlain's 1,572 in the 1971–1972 season)

funFacts.text: Chamberlain's later-career Lakers reinvented his role around rebounding, defending and outlet passing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He re-tooled Wilt Chamberlain's game to focus on defense, rebounding

funFacts.text: Rodman's sensational Pistons season was the closest a modern rebounding specialist came to Wilt's older benchmark.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His 1,530 season rebounds (the most since Wilt Chamberlain's 1,572 in the 1971–1972 season)

funFacts.text: That Lakers squad reached the title series by eliminating Kareem's defending-champion Milwaukee Bucks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Western Conference Finals: 4–2
